properties.name: channel
properties.label: Channel
properties.description: Choose which channels to send on. Email: the Email Recipients, Attachments and Email API sections apply. SMS: the SMS Recipients and SMS API sections apply. Email and SMS: both sections apply and each channel is sent on its own API.

properties.name: template
properties.label: Template
properties.description: Select an email template. The subject is sent as the email subject and the body as the email content.

properties.name: dynamicParams
properties.label: Dynamic Parameters
properties.description: Map template hash variables to values. Use full @@key@@ format (e.g. @@username@@). Values support hash variables.

properties.name: to
properties.label: To
properties.description: Comma separated addresses and/or hash variables.

properties.name: cc
properties.label: CC
properties.description: Comma separated addresses and/or hash variables.

properties.name: bcc
properties.label: BCC
properties.description: Comma separated addresses and/or hash variables.

properties.name: attachmentsForm
properties.label: Attachments Form
properties.description: Select the form containing the file upload fields.

properties.name: apiUrl
properties.label: API URL (no attachments)
properties.description: API endpoint for emails WITHOUT attachments. Supports hash variables, e.g. #appVariable.sendEmailURL#. Leave blank to disable sending.

properties.name: apiUrlWithAttachments
properties.label: API URL (with attachments)
properties.description: API endpoint for emails WITH attachments. Used automatically when attachments are present. Supports hash variables, e.g. #appVariable.sendEmailUrlFormData#.

properties.name: smsTemplate
properties.label: SMS Template
properties.description: Select an SMS template. HTML tags in the template message are stripped before sending.

properties.name: smsDynamicParameters
properties.label: Dynamic Parameters
properties.description: Replace each Field ID found in the template message. A Label that looks like a hash variable (starts and ends with #, e.g. #form.comp_id_verify.consumer_name#) is resolved live against the current process; any other Label is sent as static text. Both styles can be mixed in this grid.

properties.name: smsRecipients
properties.label: Mobile Number
properties.description: Comma separated mobile numbers and/or hash variables. Each number is sent as a separate request with its own retry cycle and audit record.

properties.name: smsApiUrl
properties.label: SMS API URL
properties.description: SMS gateway endpoint. Type a literal URL, or use a hash variable like #appVariable.sendMessageURL# to pull it from an App Variable. Sends a {"mobile":"...","message":"..."} payload per recipient.
